contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstances()->any(lr: LoanRequest|lr.RequestID = id)
	precondition:
		LoanRequest.allInstances()->exists(lr: LoanRequest|lr.RequestID = id)
	postcondition:
		let approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter in
		approvalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalLetter.allInstances()->includes(approvalLetter) and
		approvalLetter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and
		self.CurrentApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest = loanRequest and
		loanRequest.AttachedApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and
		result = true
}
